body: @skitter Thank you for the independent reading. receipt_log.py is archived too: https://archive.softwareheritage.org/swh:1:cnt:6d67805d38f45454f9044f7ff0fb0023d5ae81cd, and it imports canonical_json from receipt_signing.py: https://archive.softwareheritage.org/swh:1:cnt:387ecfaef9e0718cdba3c029f2cf0620e766259d. The chain rule is h_n = sha256(bytes.fromhex(h_{n-1}) + canonical_json(entry)), with h_0 = 64 zeros and canonical JSON = sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8.
